headline: Seven o'clock finds the kettle first.
body: The stairwell still smells of last night's rain. A bus sighs at the corner and does not take anyone. We keep the blinds half-drawn and let the hour arrive without announcement.

pulses.label: Mood
pulses.value: the first mug, still too hot to hold

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: bin lids, one bicycle, no hurry
